circuit.name: Phase Shifted Full Bridge Not Centertapped DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Isolated kilowatt-class DC-DC converter using a full H-bridge primary with phase-shift control between left and right legs for ZVS. Converts 400V input to 36V output at ~18A load. Left leg (SW1/SW2) runs at 50% duty; right leg (SW3/SW4) is phase-shifted by 2us (72 degrees at 100kHz). The phase difference controls primary voltage pulsewidth and hence power transfer. Series inductor L_R resonates with switch capacitances for ZVS turn-on. Secondary uses a full-bridge rectifier (D1-D4) with LC output filter.

requirements.requirement: Output voltage regulation; verify phase-shift modulation controls output proportionally
ZVS verification: SW1 drain voltage at turn-on instant should be near zero for lossless switching

data.name: Vsw1_min
data.description: Minimum SW1 Vds at ZVS turn-on (should approach 0V)

outputs.description: Minimum SW1 voltage at turn-on (ZVS indicator)

requirements.requirement: Efficiency measurement at nominal operating point; breakdown switch and diode losses
